title: Neoterra Pack
description: A comprehensive modpack for the neoterra server
body:
This modpack integrates all the functionalities needed to play on Solarius' _neoterra server_.

Here's a brief overview of all the features this modpack includes :
- **Create contraptions:** Using create and its addons you'll be able to make make industries, machinery, artillery, decorations and so much more, the only true limit is your imagination!

- **Player interactions:** With the simple voice chat mod and the factions mod cooperating with your teammates and friends has never been easier! No more time wasted communicating and more time playing.

- **Default server integration:** With this pack you get by default all the goodies of our server but can effortlessly played standalone in your world! In this way you can play neoterra truly your way

- **Performance, performance, performance!:** We truly value our community and we all know that playing together is MUCH better than playing alone, this is why we added the best optimization mods to ensure a smooth gameplay across most devices!

- **Universal community:** While in our big Solarius community most of us are mainly from the mediterrean region everybody here is welcome, this is why we focused on providing a good, uniform experience for everyone.





Note:
IF you want to join our server, **make sure to use _this_ pack specifically** (also make sure to have the latest stable release) to join it or the Anti-Cheat might wrongly flag you for cheating and kick or ban you right away.

For further info please visit our [discord](https://discord.gg/Ruz85Jj586) or [www.solarius.solar](https://www.solarius.solar/)
